Build a premium, modern and visually stunning website for a fictional café named "BREW & BLOOM CAFÉ" located in Haldia, West Bengal.

DESIGN:
Create a sophisticated café brand using warm cream, dark espresso brown, muted sage green and terracotta orange. Use beautiful coffee and food photography, elegant typography, clean layouts, rounded cards and subtle animations. The website must look like a professionally designed real business website, not a generic AI template.

SECTIONS:

1. Sticky navigation with logo, Home, Menu, About, Gallery and Contact.
2. Hero section with a stunning café image, headline "Good Coffee. Slow Moments. Beautiful Days.", a short description and "Explore Our Menu" and "Order on WhatsApp" buttons.
3. Featured menu with coffee, tea, cold beverages, pastries and snacks. Display editable sample prices.
4. About section with a short café story and attractive imagery.
5. Photo gallery with a polished responsive grid.
6. Bestsellers section with visually attractive menu cards.
7. Location and opening hours with editable placeholders and a configurable Google Maps link.
8. Contact section with phone, address and WhatsApp CTA.
9. Elegant footer with social links and navigation.

FUNCTIONALITY:

* Make every navigation link and button work.
* Menu button scrolls to the menu section.
* WhatsApp ordering opens a prefilled message containing the selected item. Keep the WhatsApp number configurable in one place.
* Add a mobile hamburger menu.
* Make the layout responsive on mobile, tablet and desktop.
* Add subtle hover effects and smooth scrolling.
* Optimise images and basic SEO.
* Do not invent a real café address, phone number, reviews or business claims.
* Clearly identify sample menu items and prices as demo content.
* Do not implement a fake checkout or pretend orders are stored.
* Avoid paid APIs and unnecessary dependencies.

First inspect the existing project structure. Build this as a separate project so the existing coaching website remains unchanged. Run the website, test all interactions, fix errors and provide deployment instructions for Vercel.

Prioritise visual quality, mobile usability, speed and real functionality.
</USER_REQUEST>
